as_told.title: Eggs taken and the 2002 cloned baby Eve

related.note: Both are about what was done to women taken to Zorro Ranch. The existing story claims they were to be inseminated in a breeding program; this telling claims their eggs were harvested.

plain: Some women who were taken to Zorro Ranch, a New Mexico property the episode ties to Jeffrey Epstein, believe their eggs were harvested there for human cloning. A woman named Juliet Byron tells Michels she was taken there in September 2002, thinks they took her eggs, and points out that the birth of a reportedly cloned baby called Eve was announced that December, after which, she says, nobody heard anything more. A guest named Jay Anderson repeats her account on the same show, saying she and other women share the belief and linking it to claims of a breeding program at the ranch. If true, it would put the ranch at the center of secret human experiments.
